intro: The Gambia follows the river for about 400 km and is never more than about 50 km wide.

chapters.title: The river
text: The Gambia River runs through the whole country, with mangroves, birds and hippos. The coast near Banjul has beaches.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Hot and sunny, with rain from June to October.

keyTerms.meaning: Trees that grow in salty water.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Gambia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
